status: OBSERVED_UNBOUND - Host identity facts below were honestly observed on the real candidate host with the recorded commands; they match the PRD-pinned class (macOS 26.4.1, Apple M4 Pro). The environment is still UNBOUND: every measurement/analyzer tool identity is OWNER_DECISION_PENDING, run-time snapshot fields freeze only at measurement time, and no sample may be collected before the attested plan freeze.

provenance.class: owner-operated Apple Silicon workstation, native execution (no VM, no container)
provenance.rationale: PRD US-008: primary measurements run natively on the pinned macOS Apple M4 Pro environment.

power_source_state.freeze_procedure: Record 'pmset -g batt' immediately before and after every sample run; AC power is required by run_policy.power_policy and any battery-power interval invalidates the run.

low_power_mode_state.freeze_procedure: Record 'pmset -g | grep lowpowermode' before every run block; Low Power Mode must be 0 and any other value invalidates the run.

thermal_pressure_state.freeze_procedure: Record 'thermal levels' via the bound measurement tooling for the whole run window; any throttle event invalidates the run (fail-closed).

background_process_census.freeze_procedure: Record the process table and aggregate non-benchmark CPU immediately before each run; aggregate background CPU above 2% invalidates the run.

clock_sync_state.freeze_procedure: Record 'sntp -d time.apple.com' (or the bound tool's equivalent) offset before each run block so latency samples carry a clock-state record.

thermal_power_identity_policy.value: fail-closed: any thermal throttle event, power-state anomaly, or host/tool identity mismatch during a run invalidates the run (INCONCLUSIVE, never patched or resampled around)

power_policy.value: AC power connected for the entire run block; Low Power Mode disabled; system sleep and display-sleep-triggered app nap disabled for the benchmark processes; no user-interactive session activity during samples.
power_policy.rationale: The PRD pins the environment class and fail-closed rules but not the power procedure; freezing it now removes a post-hoc degree of freedom.
